blocks.text: CLEANOUT FAQ
Cleanout Services in Caledon — Country Questions, Honest Answers

items.q: How much do cleanout services cost in Caledon?
a: Truck volume decides, and only truck volume: small cleanouts from $125, full properties scaling openly with what their contents fill — with zero distance or access premium anywhere in the township. The exact figure is written free at the walkthrough and holds to the invoice.

items.q: Can one booking really clear the house and every outbuilding?
a: That’s the Caledon specialty. The walkthrough scopes every structure, the quote covers the whole property, and the sweep runs building by building — house, drive shed, barn, workshop — until nothing’s left uncleared. No separate visit needed for the shed.

items.q: How do you handle a farm cleanout with generations of belongings?
a: With patience across every building. Keepsakes, papers and valuables get set aside wherever they surface — farmhouse dresser or barn rafter alike — meaningful finds go to the family rather than a bin, and equipment or scrap sorts for proper recycling. Executors get updates and documentation without needing to make the drive.

items.q: What about old chemicals, fuel or paint in the outbuildings?
a: We don’t landfill them, ever. Anything hazardous gets gathered, flagged and pointed toward the nearest household-hazardous-waste depot for proper disposal — a small, honest exception inside an otherwise complete clear.

items.q: Is a hoarding cleanout really private out here, where everyone knows everyone?
a: Especially out here, yes. Unmarked scheduling, no commentary, staging kept off the road’s sightline, and a respectful pace throughout. Caledon talks — but never because of us.

items.q: Do rural addresses or long laneways cost extra?
a: Never. The same flat volume pricing applies at Caledon East’s village core and eight concessions past it — no distance fee, no per-building fee, no access charge.

items.q: Where do all the belongings go?
a: Donation first: furniture, housewares and usable goods to charity partners; metals, appliances, equipment and e-waste to licensed recyclers; landfill strictly last. The split documents on request for estates, sales or your own records.
